description: Stay prepared with Rothco’s 5-in-1 Multi-Purpose Tool. This unique survival tool is engineered with a variety of interchangeable parts, ensuring you are well prepared for any outdoor activity. The survivalist tool offers a shovel, saw, pick axe, axe head, flat stake hammer, and tent stake puller attachments for ultimate outdoor convenience and utility. The bottom handle features a removable compass, allowing you to get your bearings wherever the adventure takes you. The tool comes with a carrying case, and the handle stores fishing line, tinder, or other survival essentials. With a heavy-duty steel construction with rubber grip, this multi-tool easily withstands the demanding outdoor elements and harsh weather conditions. From a weekend camping trip to trekking in the mountains, make sure you’re ready for anything with our 5-in-1 Multi-Purpose Tool.
